beats.say: American football is officially heading to the 2028 Olympic Games in Los Angeles.
Fort Meade in Maryland is now generally accepted as the birthplace of flag football.
In July 2022, the National Football League and the International Federation of American Football partnered on a bid for the Games.
Flag football was shortlisted as one of nine sports advancing to the next phase.
In October 2023, the Los Angeles organizing committee proposed flag football, and it was officially approved at the 141st IOC Session.
Flag football will be a discretionary event for the 2028 Summer Olympics in Los Angeles.
This marks the first time any gridiron football code has been a full part of an Olympic program. Will you be watching?
